$ref.description: Path to content that replaces the $ref

area.description: Horizontal area this subscription should cover.

duration.description: Duration of the subscription, from the time it is created.

max_alt.description: Altitude above which this subscription should not apply.

min_alt.description: Altitude below which this subscription should not apply.

notify_for_constraints.description: Whether to receive notifications for constraints. Defaults to False if not specified.

notify_for_op_intents.description: Whether to receive notifications for operational intents. Defaults to True if not specified.

subscription_id.description: ID of the single subscription to create.
